findings.evidenceJa: そいつの仕事じゃないの
findings.governingReading: Shinji suggests that the bounded field may be the work of the other Master at school.
findings.explanation: The English both genders the unknown Master and strengthens Shinji’s conjecture into necessity.

findings.highlight: we’re people that go under the radars of the normal Masters
findings.evidenceJa: 僕は普通のマスターたちのレーダーに映らない存在なんだよ
findings.governingReading: Shinji claims that he personally does not register on ordinary Masters’ radar.
findings.explanation: The English changes the singular speaker into an unspecified plural group and produces an unnatural plural “radars.”

findings.highlight: the presence of a Master that Tohsaka is searching for
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂が追っている[ruby text=マスター char=2]魔力の気配そのもの
findings.governingReading: Shinji lacks the magical-energy presence that Rin tracks as the sign of a Master.
findings.explanation: The English follows only the ruby reading and drops the underlying magical-energy layer that explains the inference.

findings.highlight: it’ll be a problem if we don’t do something about it fast
findings.evidenceJa: 早めに叩かないと厄介らしい
findings.governingReading: Rider reportedly says the temple threat must be struck early before it becomes troublesome.
findings.explanation: “Do something about it” weakens the specific proposal to attack.

findings.highlight: there’s a high probability that it is the cause of the story on this morning’s news
findings.evidenceJa: 今朝のニュースの元凶である可能性が高い
findings.governingReading: Shirou thinks the soul collection is likely the underlying cause of the incident reported that morning.
findings.explanation: The English makes the entity the cause of a news story rather than the events the story reports.

findings.highlight: So ordered by Shinji, Rider approaches me.
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二に命じられ、ライダーが近寄ってくる
findings.governingReading: Ordered by Shinji, Rider approaches Shirou.
findings.explanation: The dangling introductory construction is unnatural and obscures the simple command-response action.

findings.highlight: He has nothing to do with me once he exits
findings.evidenceJa: 外にさえ出てくれたら僕とは無関係だから
findings.governingReading: Once Shirou is outside, Shinji disclaims responsibility for whatever happens to him.
findings.explanation: The English turns a chilling cutoff of responsibility into a vague denial of personal relationship.

findings.governingReading: Up close, Rider has unexpectedly refined, demure features.
findings.explanation: “Clean features” is unnatural and loses the characterizing impression of 清楚.

findings.highlight: a shrine maiden covered in blood
findings.governingReading: Shirou sums Rider’s contradictory appearance up with the image of a shrine maiden wet with blood.
findings.explanation: The English presents the figurative visual summary as a literal physical state.

findings.highlight: looking up at Rider’s face out of [r]curiosit
findings.evidenceJa: 怖い物見たさでライダーの顔を見上げていると
findings.governingReading: Shirou looks up at Rider’s face from fearful curiosity before his thought veers toward her height.
findings.explanation: A malformed control-like fragment visibly corrupts “curiosity” and interrupts the comic turn.
